scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'])fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});if(!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Use pnpm instead');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck:product && pnpm run build:product
scripts.build:product: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/privacy-compliance-manager run build
scripts.typecheck:product: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/privacy-compliance-manager run typecheck
scripts.test:product: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/privacy-compliance-manager run test
